svg.title: Silhouette halls backdrop, night 7: toward the call
svg.desc: Silhouette halls backdrop for night 7, toward the call: the tall hall side-on as a lit cream sheet, windows at 3.5 m throwing light long and down, the pipe run at 2.7 m, claw marks higher than a man; no guards, every window lit, a door standing open, the colour gone out of the sheet and frost running along the floor from the pale far end.
